Chapter 2: The Journey

The journey through Curator's features was enlightening. Testing the EPUB utilities revealed the power of well-structured digital books.

Key features tested include:

  • Metadata extraction from EPUB files
  • Table of contents parsing
  • Chapter navigation
  • Cover image extraction
  • Spine structure validation

Each feature proved essential for managing a comprehensive digital library. The ability to parse and understand EPUB structure allowed for intelligent organization and cataloging.

This test file ensures that the Curator application can handle real-world EPUB files with multiple chapters, proper metadata, and valid structure conforming to EPUB 3.0 specifications.
